name: Clean-up suggestions
author: Lichtspiel
description: Once a day, shows admins under Settings what could go when the disk fills up: titles nobody watched for a long time, titles everyone has seen, and the biggest files for their running time. Nothing is deleted by itself: each title has a Delete button, shown only when media deletion is allowed. Settings: months without watching (unwatched_months, default 12), the people who count for "everyone has seen it" by user name (people; empty = everyone), libraries to leave out by name (skip_libraries).
